title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Payment Plan Terms: Rounding of Installments
content:
Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program — Payment Plan Terms for Patients

**Rounding of each installment**

1. The rounding adjustment replaces the standard rounding of each installment by the way the customer pays: when the program's latest payment was made by debit card, credit card or HSA or FSA card, each installment is rounded up to the next cent; when it was made by check or bank transfer, each installment is rounded up to the next whole dollar; otherwise the standard rounding applies, to the nearest cent, a half cent going to the even cent.

2. *The program's latest payment* is the patient payment most recently posted on the customer's Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program enrollment, and its method is the payment method that posting shows. Where no patient payment has been posted on the enrollment, the standard rounding applies: to the nearest cent, a half cent going to the even cent.

3. The amount rounded is the plan balance of an interest-free payment plan on the enrollment divided by its number of installments. *Rounded up to the next cent* means raised to the smallest whole number of cents not less than that amount; *rounded up to the next whole dollar* means raised to the smallest whole number of dollars not less than that amount; an amount that is already a whole number of cents, or of dollars, stays as it is. *Rounded to the nearest cent, a half cent going to the even cent* means taken to the closer cent, an amount lying exactly halfway between two cents going to the one whose last digit is even. The installment so rounded is the monthly amount of the plan.

| Method of the latest payment on the enrollment | Each installment |
|---|---|
| debit card, credit card, HSA or FSA card | rounded up to the next cent |
| check, bank transfer | rounded up to the next whole dollar |
| no payment posted | the standard rounding: to the nearest cent, a half cent going to the even cent |

4. Illustration on hypothetical figures, each plan balance spread over 8 installments:

| Plan balance, divided by 8 | Card | Check or bank transfer | No payment posted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 338.10, giving 42.2625 | 42.27 | 43.00 | 42.26 |
| 338.20, giving 42.275 | 42.28 | 43.00 | 42.28 (halfway; 28 is even) |
| 338.12, giving 42.265 | 42.27 | 43.00 | 42.26 (halfway; 26 is even) |
| 336.00, giving exactly 42.00 | 42.00 | 42.00 | 42.00 |
